title: Friendgroup create server
description: Mainly based around Create: Areonautics ,but has a couple other things.
body:
## Welcome
### Features
This modpack Features mainly The Create mod and a ton of its addons. This Modpack also features mods that add vehicles like Immersive Aircraft. This also includes Create: Areonautics. There's a few QoL mods but currently we have Serene Seasons as a major QoL mod.

### Why download this?
Supposedly your're looking for a cool modpack with a bunch of cool mods, or maybe just browsing. Well if you're looking for a modpack that has well over 10 create mod additions in create 6.0.8+, and has survival-friendly Create mods. Congrats, This ModPack is for you.
Whether this is used for our server or not, We hope you have a fun time with this modpack.

### Info
- This modpack is built for my friendgroup's server PC that we host on.
- This is a decently heavy modpack with around 150 mods.
- We are always trying bug fix whenever there is a bug.
- Currently we are switching to NeoForge/1.21.1 to add Create: Areonautics.
- We Highly suggest adding some of your own mods to fit your needs.
